notes: καταμαρτυροῦσιν σου -> 'witness against thee' gave 'against' to the verb as its κατα- element. Rule 69 names exactly this shape for a κατα-compound governing an oblique case and puts the preposition on the governed word (οὐ κατενάρκησα οὐθενός -> 'on any man'), and the corpus aligns ὑμῖν -> 'against you' at JAS.5.3. Moved 'against' to σου, bringing the verse into line with 14.5, 14.46, 14.53 and 14.65.
